metadata.purpose: Route values through successive live windows; each fresh closing signal ends the current window on next or complete.

conditions: One initial window plus one successor for each admitted closing next or completion.
Only current-window consumers receive source values; windows and values are not replayed.
Source completion/error ends current children before outer; outer cancellation leaves orphaned child Subjects.

scope.parameters: No numeric parameters. A synchronous closing factory returns a valid Observable whose acquisition is non-notifying, or throws an opaque error.
scope.callbacks: Factory requests have generation equal to the new window identity. Explicit return/throw must match the current invocation at the same envelope time.
scope.time: No timer is introduced. Source and closing streams provide notification times. Equal-time ordering is explicit; runWindowWhenTrace enforces same-time factory outcomes.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant reactions; child attachment occurs between completed reactions. Source and closing acquisition do not synchronously notify.
exclusions: Synchronous closing notifications during subscription, recursively empty closing streams, and reentrant factory/observer/source setup.
Child attachment during the synchronous handle-announcement/factory reaction; native tests characterize this separately.
ObservableInput conversion beyond valid Observable values, imperative Subject mutation and source setup that emits despite a closed subscriber.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Emit initial handle; invoke selector; acquire returned closing Observable; acquire source last. Initial selector throw still attempts source setup with a closed subscriber.

ownership.sharing: Independent outer subscriptions have separate windows and closing occurrences. Inner windows are live multicast without replay; inner consumers hold no upstream lease.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered action words are model predictions, not executed effects. Callback invocation IDs correlate outcomes; they are not subscription IDs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

rules.nextState: New window retains the exact error; old windows remain completed.
rules.explanation: Initial selector failure still reaches source.subscribe with an already closed subscriber. This non-notifying setup attempt acquires and immediately releases the source.

actions: forward identical payload to every observer of the current window in attachment order
rules.nextState: No values are buffered and no closing state changes.
rules.explanation: Late observers miss earlier values. The outer sequence contains window handles, not source payloads.
